queries_run: Fortinet business model transition subscription platform SASE 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：Fortinet 仍主要經兩層經銷模式銷售（經銷商→轉售商／服務商／MSSP→終端客戶），僅在特定情況直銷大型客戶；雲端訂閱另透過自有資料中心與公有雲提供。
findings.excerpt: We primarily sell our products and services through a two-tier distribution model. We sell to distributors that sell to resellers and to service providers and managed security service providers (“MSSPs”), who, in turn, sell products and/or services to end-customers. In certain cases, we sell directly to large service providers, major systems integrators and large end users.

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：產品組合含硬體、軟體授權、SaaS 訂閱與雲端交付方案，並透過雲服務商平台銷售軟體授權與雲交付服務。
findings.excerpt: We also sell our software licenses and cloud delivered services via different cloud service provider platforms, both directly and through our channel partners.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋摘要為二手整理（Climb 美國、Adistec 巴西新增專業經銷商；SASE/SecOps ARR 揭露、服務佔比約70%），未取得可逐字原文，列於 clues；一手文件顯示通路仍為兩層經銷，未見去中介化。

clues.claim: 專業經銷商 Climb 自 2025-12 起銷售 Fortinet，2026 目標含 SMB/中型市場經合作夥伴成長（通路擴張而非縮減）。
clues.source: Channel Insider: Climb & Fortinet Execs on New US Partnership, 2026 Goals

clues.claim: 服務與支援營收約佔 2025 年營收 70%（自約 48%），訂閱化轉型；並開始揭露 SASE 與 SecOps ARR。
clues.source: Zacks/Nasdaq: FTNT's Subscription-Based Services Gain Steam
